posts.label: Market Update
posts.alt: Scottsdale market update post: homes sold a week faster
posts.caption: Scottsdale single family homes sold a week faster. In October, single family homes spent 75 days on the market, down from 82 a year ago, while 1,480 homes were for sale, about even with a year ago. Same choice for buyers, a quicker pace. Source: Phoenix REALTORS, ARMLS data, October 2026. #ScottsdaleAZ #ScottsdaleRealEstate
